content:
October 18th, 2026

A spooky movie, your favorite snacks, and an October night at Boulder Reservoir—this is Halloween with a distinctly Boulder backdrop.

The City of Boulder’s Halloween Drive-In Movies series continues Friday, October 23, 2026, with Poltergeist. Following the October 16 screening of Coco, the next installment turns up the scares with a horror selection best suited to viewers comfortable with frightening scenes.

The Details

  • When: Friday, October 23; movie begins at 7:30 p.m.
  • Where: Boulder Reservoir’s main parking lot. The ticket listing gives the address as 5100 51st Street, Boulder.
  • Admission: $30 per carload.
  • Included: One movie, one parking space, and one goody bag per vehicle.

Purchase one ticket per car, with no more passengers than your vehicle can legally accommodate. Check availability and reserve through the official Poltergeist registration page.

Come Hungry—and Bring the Dog

Lakeside Café is scheduled to open at 5 p.m., serving popcorn, hot dogs, soft-serve ice cream, snacks, nonalcoholic drinks, and bar beverages. Attendees are welcome to check in early and enjoy the café before the screening.

You may also bring your own food, but outside alcohol and glass containers are prohibited. Pack out everything you bring.

Dogs are welcome and must be leashed outside the vehicle. Bring water for your companion and warm layers and blankets for yourself.

Before You Go

Fires, grills, open trunks, swimming, and boating are prohibited during the event. Review your confirmation for parking and arrival instructions.

Tickets are nontransferable, and refunds are unavailable within 48 hours of the event. For refund assistance or online waitlist details, visit the city’s Halloween Drive-In Movies page.

For anyone looking for things to do around Boulder, this is a simple way to give Friday night a seasonal twist. Gather your movie crew, reserve your vehicle’s spot, and let Poltergeist supply the Halloween chills.
